conditions.text: Preconditions to set up, all consistent across every event: app version 3.3.0 on iOS 18.4, device iPhone15,2 (values come from Sentry contexts).

Account and push state are unknown for all 3 events (push.deliverable, push.os_permission, push.provider_registration, profile.consistent were not captured), so it is not established whether any particular account setup is required.
The packet records no varying attributes beyond that gap, so nothing here can be marked as optional or irrelevant with confidence.

As a lead only: commit c33a666 "MEI-60: Weather widget on home" touches the same file as the culprit frame, src/modules/weather/widget.vue, so a build containing that change may be relevant to reproduction; this is not a proven cause.

missing_evidence_questions.text: What was the account state at crash time, specifically push.deliverable, push.os_permission, push.provider_registration and profile.consistent, which are unknown for all 3 events?
What makes location undefined at src/modules/weather/widget.vue line 19 in render, and where is location supposed to be populated from before the widget renders?
Does the issue reproduce only on app version 3.3.0 / iOS 18.4 / iPhone15,2, or do other versions, OS versions and devices also hit it? The packet only shows these values.
Did the error start appearing with commit c33a666, and does reverting or building before it stop the failure?
Are there additional user actions or state between foregrounding and navigating to /home that the 3 captured events did not record?

steps_prose.text: Bring the app to the foreground; this lifecycle step was present in all 3 events considered.
Navigate to /home, which was also present in every event.
Observe the failure: an Error with value "Weather widget: location undefined" surfacing at src/modules/weather/widget.vue, function render, line 19.

summary.text: The incident is an Error "Weather widget: location undefined" thrown in the weather widget's render function, seen across 3 events when the app is foregrounded and the user lands on the home screen.
